method: Each JQL executed through the Atlassian connector (searchJiraIssuesUsingJql); keys transcribed from the responses.

filters.name: KAN | Open demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, due ASC
filters.purpose: Working list of all open demands.

filters.name: KAN | Overdue open demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND due < startOfDay() ORDER BY due ASC
filters.purpose: Open demands past their required-by date.

filters.name: KAN | Open demands without owner
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND assignee IS EMPTY ORDER BY created ASC

filters.name: KAN | No activity for 7 days
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND updated <= -7d ORDER BY updated ASC
filters.purpose: Open demands nobody has touched for a week.

filters.name: KAN | High-priority open demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND priority in (Highest, High) ORDER BY priority DESC, due ASC
filters.purpose: Review order for the demand board.

filters.name: KAN | Pending assessment
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels in (stage-triaged, stage-assessment) ORDER BY due ASC

filters.name: KAN | Ready for decision
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels = stage-ready-for-decision ORDER BY priority DESC
filters.purpose: Agenda of the next demand board.

filters.name: KAN | Waiting for requester
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels = stage-needs-info ORDER BY updated ASC

filters.name: KAN | Needs finance review
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = needs-finance-review ORDER BY priority DESC
filters.purpose: Funding gate fails or recurring cost is high.

filters.name: KAN | Security review pending
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = needs-security-review ORDER BY priority DESC
filters.purpose: Security-sensitive demands without a passed review.

filters.name: KAN | Blocked or deferred
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels in (blocked, stage-deferred) ORDER BY due ASC
filters.purpose: Work that is not moving, with the reason in the issue.

filters.name: KAN | Completed in the last 30 days
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels = stage-complete AND statusCategoryChangedDate >= -30d ORDER BY statusCategoryChangedDate DESC

filters.name: KAN | Team Platform and Storage
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = team-plat ORDER BY due ASC
filters.purpose: Open demands of the Platform and Storage team.

filters.name: KAN | Team Network and Access
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = team-net ORDER BY due ASC
filters.purpose: Open demands of the Network and Access team.

filters.name: KAN | Team Security Engineering
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = team-sec ORDER BY due ASC
filters.purpose: Open demands of the Security Engineering team.

filters.name: KAN | Management attention
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND (due < startOfDay() OR assignee IS EMPTY OR labels in (blocked, needs-finance-review)) ORDER BY priority DESC
filters.purpose: Overdue, unowned, blocked or unfunded open demands.
